name: Bonded Mind [Teamwork]
body:
You and your partner are so close that you can almost read each other’s minds.

Benefit(s): As long as you can see each other, you and an ally can trade nonverbal messages. These function as the message spell, except that you don’t need to whisper or point, and you cannot be overheard.
